comparison.objective: Bread all faces of a chicken tender while minimizing subsequent handling, versus tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Press deformable breading onto food and manage grasp count/contact; no precision mechanism adjustment or fixture testing.
comparison.success_condition: Required face coverage and limited post-breading grips, rather than repeatable bounded carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Deformable coating and handling economy test a wholly different ability.
